# pve_notification_matcher (Data Source)

Reads a single notification matcher from `GET /cluster/notifications/matchers/{name}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_notification_matcher" "ops" {
  name = "ops"
}

output "matcher_targets" {
  value = data.pve_notification_matcher.ops.target
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The matcher name to look up.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Description of the matcher; null when unset.
- `digest` (String) Upstream configuration digest; changes whenever the matcher is edited out of band.
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether this matcher is disabled.
- `invert_match` (Boolean) Whether the match result of the whole matcher is inverted.
- `match_calendar` (List of String) Calendar-event windows the notification timestamp must fall in.
- `match_field` (List of String) Metadata match conditions, each in the form `(regex|exact):<field>=<value>`.
- `match_severity` (List of String) Notification severities to match (e.g. `info`, `notice`, `warning`, `error`, `unknown`).
- `mode` (String) How multiple conditions combine: `all` or `any`.
- `origin` (String) Whether the matcher is `user-created`, `builtin`, or a `modified-builtin`.
- `target` (List of String) Names of the notification targets the matcher routes to.
